in respect of the work Huru SMS – Multichannel SMS and Web Citizen Information and Guidance System for Tanzania, version 1.0

THIS AGREEMENT is made on the 12th day of October 2026 at Dar es Salaam

BETWEEN

HURU DIGITAL LIMITED, a company incorporated on 4 May 2021 under the Companies Act, Cap. 212 of the Laws of Tanzania, with registration number 151790429, of Mlalakuwa Street, Makongo Ward, Kinondoni District, P.O. Box 75290, Dar es Salaam, United Republic of Tanzania, represented by its Managing Director, IBRAHIM FRANK NDUNGURU (the "Company"), of the one part;

AND

MICHAEL SIMON KILUNGA, an individual of Tanzanian nationality, holder of National Identification Number (NIN) 19991208-37305-00002-27, of P.O. Box 75290, Dar es Salaam, United Republic of Tanzania (the "Developer"), of the other part.

RECITALS

  1. A.  The Developer designed, programmed, tested and delivered the computer program known as Huru SMS, a server application that receives questions by SMS (keyword HURU to shortcode 15054) and web chat, assembles Tanzanian context and verified knowledge, obtains a worded reply and sends it back to the citizen, together with its administration panel (the "Work").
  2. B.  The Company intends to own all rights in the Work, to exploit it commercially and for the public benefit, and to register it in its own name with the Copyright Society of Tanzania (COSOTA) under the Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Act, Cap. 218 of the Laws of Tanzania.
  3. C.  The Developer's contribution was made for the Company and, to the extent that it was not already made under a contract of employment or commission with the Company, the parties wish to record in writing the assignment of all economic rights in that contribution to the Company, together with the terms on which it was made.

NOW THEREFORE IT IS AGREED as follows:

1. Definitions

In this Agreement: "Work" means Huru SMS – Multichannel SMS and Web Citizen Information and Guidance System for Tanzania, version 1.0, including all versions, source code, object code, databases, designs, texts, images, documentation and other materials forming part of it, as described in the Innovation Documentation, the System Design and Architecture document and the Source Code Listing deposited with COSOTA; "Contribution" means every part of the Work created by the Developer as described in Clause 2 and the Schedule; "Economic Rights" means all rights of reproduction, translation, adaptation, arrangement, distribution, rental, public display, communication to the public, making available and any other right of exploitation conferred by the Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Act, Cap. 218, or by the law of any other country; "Moral Rights" means the right to claim authorship and the right to object to distortion or modification of the Work.

2. The Contribution

The Developer confirms having created the following for the Company:

  1. 2.1  The software architecture of the Work and all original source code written for it: the conversation engine (ConversationService, TopicClassifier, LanguageDetector, TanzaniaContext, KnowledgeRetriever, PromptEngine, AiService, ModerationService), the SMS and language-model integrations, the web chat, the public website and community, the administration panel, the background jobs, the console commands and the automated tests.
  2. 2.2  The database design (migrations), the data seeders, the configuration schema and the settings system.
  3. 2.3  The build, installation and deployment configuration described in the README, including the service worker and application manifest.
  4. 2.4  All bug fixes, improvements, new versions and derivative works of the above made by the Developer for the Company during the term of this Agreement.

The Contribution is embodied in the complete source code reproduced in the Source Code Listing (112 files, 7,991 lines), the database migrations and seeders, the automated tests, the README and the System Design and Architecture document, copies of which have been delivered to the Company.

3. Engagement and period

The Contribution was made during the year 2026, the Work being completed in October 2026, at the request of and for the Company. The Developer was at the material time engaged by the Company as the developer of the software and the creator of the designs.

4. Consideration

In consideration of the assignment and undertakings in this Agreement the Company has paid or shall pay to the Developer:

  1. ☐ the sum of Tanzanian Shillings ______________________________ (TZS ______________), receipt of which the Developer acknowledges; and/or
  2. ☑ the remuneration and benefits received by the Developer from the Company in connection with the Work and the Developer's role in the Company, which the parties agree is full and adequate consideration; and/or
  3. ☐ other: ______________________________________________________.

5. Assignment of copyright

5.1  The Developer hereby assigns to the Company, absolutely and with full title guarantee, all Economic Rights and all other intellectual property rights in the Contribution and in the Work, throughout the world, for the whole term of copyright including all renewals, extensions and reversions, and including the right to sue for and recover damages for past infringements.

5.2  To the extent that any part of the Contribution was created under a contract of employment with, or on commission from, the Company, the parties confirm that the Economic Rights in it vested in the Company from creation in accordance with the Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Act, Cap. 218, and this Clause operates as confirmation of that vesting.

5.3  The Company may register, license, assign, adapt, translate, modify, combine with other works, and exploit the Work in any manner and medium, now known or later devised, without further consent of or payment to the Developer.

5.4  Any part of the Contribution that cannot be assigned under applicable law is hereby licensed to the Company exclusively, irrevocably, worldwide, royalty-free and for the full term of protection.

6. Moral rights

The Developer retains the Moral Rights that the law does not permit to be assigned. The Developer agrees (a) to be identified as the Developer of the Contribution in the COSOTA register and in formal documentation, and (b) not to assert any Moral Right so as to prevent or restrict the Company's modification, adaptation, translation, combination or exploitation of the Work in the ordinary course of its business, and waives any such right to the extent permitted by law.

7. Warranties

The Developer warrants that: (a) the Contribution is the Developer's own original work, except for third-party material identified in writing to the Company; (b) the Contribution does not infringe the copyright or other rights of any person; (c) Developer has not previously assigned, licensed or encumbered any right in the Contribution and has full power to enter into this Agreement; (d) to the Developer's knowledge no other person is entitled to claim authorship of or rights in the Contribution; and (e) the information given in this Agreement and in the COSOTA application is true.

8. Confidentiality

The Developer shall keep confidential, and shall not use or disclose except for the Company's purposes, all non-public information about the Work, its source code, configuration, keys, data, users and business plans, during and after the term of this Agreement.

9. Further assurance

The Developer shall, at the Company's request and expense, sign all documents and do all things reasonably required to register, confirm, protect or enforce the Company's rights in the Work before COSOTA, the Business Registrations and Licensing Agency, or any authority or court in Tanzania or elsewhere, and hereby appoints the Company as attorney to sign such documents in the Developer's name if the Developer fails to do so within fourteen (14) days of a written request.

10. Delivery and hand-over

The Developer has delivered to the Company the complete source code of the Work in a form that can be installed and run following the README, together with all credentials, configuration values, keys and accounts required to operate the Work. The Developer shall not retain any copy of the Work except as authorised in writing by the Company for maintenance.

11. Third-party and open-source components

The Work uses third-party open-source components (in particular the Laravel framework and the libraries listed in composer.json and package.json) under their own licences. The Developer warrants that (a) these components are used in accordance with their licences, (b) no component is used under a licence that would require the Company to disclose or license the Work's own source code, and (c) the components are clearly separable from the original code of the Work, which is the subject of this assignment. Ownership of such components remains with their respective authors and is not transferred by this Agreement.

12. Development tools

The Developer may use editors, frameworks, code generators, testing tools and other software development aids in producing the Work. The Developer remains responsible for directing, reviewing, integrating and testing all code so produced and confirms that the Work as delivered is the result of the Developer's own skill, judgement and labour.

13. Quality and correction of defects

The Developer warrants that the Work performs materially as described in the Innovation Documentation and the System Design and Architecture document and passes its automated tests. For a period of ninety (90) days from delivery the Developer shall correct, without additional charge, any defect reported by the Company that prevents the Work from performing as so described.

14. Security

The Developer shall not introduce into the Work any malicious code, back door, undisclosed remote access or time-limited function, and warrants that secret keys and passwords are kept only in the environment configuration and are not embedded in the source code.

15. Maintenance and further development

Any maintenance, hosting or further development after delivery shall be agreed separately; all results of such further work shall also belong to the Company under the terms of Clause 5.

16. Governing law and disputes

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the United Republic of Tanzania. Any dispute arising out of or in connection with it shall first be referred to the parties' amicable discussion for thirty (30) days; failing settlement, it shall be referred to arbitration in accordance with the Arbitration Act, 2020 of Tanzania, by a single arbitrator sitting at Dar es Salaam, or, if the parties so agree, to the courts of Tanzania.

17. General

This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties on its subject matter and supersedes any earlier understanding. It may be varied only in writing signed by both parties. If any provision is held invalid, the remainder continues in force. It may be signed in counterparts, each of which is an original. Notices shall be in writing to the addresses above.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties have signed this Agreement on the date first written above.

SCHEDULE – Description of the Work and the Contribution

Title of the Work: Huru SMS

Full description: Huru SMS – Multichannel SMS and Web Citizen Information and Guidance System for Tanzania, version 1.0. A multichannel digital service through which any person in Tanzania asks a question in Kiswahili or English by SMS (the keyword HURU followed by the question, sent to shortcode 15054) or through a web chat, and receives a short, practical answer grounded in Tanzanian law, institutions, places and verified knowledge, with referral to nearby services and official contacts. The Work comprises the server application (PHP / Laravel), its database design, the web chat and public website, the administration panel, the written content in both languages, the visual designs, and the accompanying documentation.

Owner and applicant: HURU DIGITAL LIMITED

Version: 1.0     Year of completion: 2026     Country of origin: United Republic of Tanzania

Documents deposited with COSOTA: Innovation Documentation; System Design and Architecture (with screenshots); Source Code Listing (112 files, 7,991 lines, 188 pages); the source code archive.

Contribution of the Developer (summary of Clause 2):

  1. 2.1  The software architecture of the Work and all original source code written for it: the conversation engine (ConversationService, TopicClassifier, LanguageDetector, TanzaniaContext, KnowledgeRetriever, PromptEngine, AiService, ModerationService), the SMS and language-model integrations, the web chat, the public website and community, the administration panel, the background jobs, the console commands and the automated tests.
  2. 2.2  The database design (migrations), the data seeders, the configuration schema and the settings system.
  3. 2.3  The build, installation and deployment configuration described in the README, including the service worker and application manifest.
  4. 2.4  All bug fixes, improvements, new versions and derivative works of the above made by the Developer for the Company during the term of this Agreement.

Other contributors to the Work (each under a separate contract with the Company): the author of the idea and written content; the creator of the designs; the developer of the software.
